LiGo is free software made almost entirely of other people's free work. Thank you to everyone below. The full licence details are in COPYING.md.

goscorer

KataGo
David J Wu (lightvector)		 Proposes the dead stones when a game ends and checks every puzzle. Its test positions check LiGo's rules. MIT

David J Wu (lightvector)		 The trained network KataGo scores games with (downloaded to the server, not shipped with LiGo). KataGo Neural Network License (MIT-style)
KataGo's g170 test network
David J Wu (lightvector)		 The small network that checked the puzzles, shipped in KataGo's own repository. MIT (KataGo's repository)
OGS goratings
Online-Go.com		 How ratings become kyu and dan ranks, and the handicap maths. MIT
@sabaki/sgf
